items.summary: The opinions expressed here by Trellis expert contributors are their own, not those of Trellis or its editors .

items.title: Net-zero support relies on cheap energy bills, MPs warn
items.summary: A cross-Parliamentary report has announced that public confidence in net-zero depends increasingly on delivering lower energy costs.

items.title: Business leaders set out plan to protect Scotland’s energy future
items.summary: Aberdeen & Grampian Chamber of Commerce has published an eight-point plan to rescue North Sea investment and boost Scotland's energy security.

items.title: COP31 Covered: A deal on the table and the race to build clean industry
items.summary: On COP31's Science, Industry and Technology Day, the first draft of the summit's cover decision calls for "accelerated action to phase out fossil fuels", while some countries push to side-line key climate science.

items.title: WEBINAR ON THURSDAY: How to turn climate risk insights into adaptation action
items.summary: This webinar, held in partnership with SmartResilience on 19 November, will explore why and how leading organisations are moving from simply measuring risk to actively adapting in order to protect their operations, assets and supply chains.

items.title: From a draft text to AI commitments: What happened on 16 November at COP31?
items.summary: Science, Industry and Technology Day opened with the first draft of the COP31 cover decision.

items.title: COP31’s ‘overgrown garden’: Can ministers turn a tangled draft text into a deal?
items.summary: COP31 Presidency has published the first draft of the cover decision, setting out a menu of options for ministers to wrestle with in the second week of negotiations.

items.title: UK SRS: Assessing readiness, closing gaps and preparing for implementation
items.summary: With new sustainability reporting requirements approaching for listed companies in the UK, businesses face the challenge of understanding what the UK Sustainability Reporting Standards (UK SRS) will require, identifying gaps in their existing processes and preparing for implementation.

items.title: When public services are unprepared for climate adaptation, communities pay the price
items.summary: Behind reports and risk assessments are people who depend on our public services.

items.title: Norway court voids three North Sea oilfield approvals
items.summary: Norway's Supreme Court has ruled that three oilfield decisions were unlawful, on the grounds that the Government failed to take the full environmental impact into consideration.
